🦣 TUNDRA: ICE AGE SURVIVAL [ALPHA] 🐾

Be born as a prehistoric animal and survive the frozen Pleistocene! Grow from a wobbly newborn into a legendary elder: hunt, graze, find your herd or pack, and outlast the cold.

🆕 v0.8.1 – BUNDLES!
• Sabertooth Bundle & Marsupial Lion Bundle: the animal, its rare Leucistic + Melanistic coats AND 10,000 Bones at a huge discount!
• Thylacoleo, the marsupial lion: climbs trees and ambushes prey from the branches

🐾 PLAY AS: Navahoceros, Horse, Camelops, Bison, Dire Wolf, Smilodon, Thylacoleo, Dire Bear & Woolly Mammoth

❄️ FEATURES
• Eat to grow: stop eating and you stop growing
• Latch takedowns, pounces, roars & calls
• Packs, herds & nesting with friends
• Weather, seasons & deadly cold
• Rare coats and mastery levels

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support the Alpha!
